mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine increases renal tubular reabsorption of amphetamine metabolites and may increase urinary pH, potentially altering gentamicin clearance and nephrotoxicity risk; gentamicin nephrotoxicity may be potentiated in the presence of sympathomimetic stimulation.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and gentamicin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
